ingestion_flows.source_description: TC-PRM-005: small ACME Corp export-staging batch, Auto Loader-ingested into a genuine streaming table (target_type 'external_sink') and, inside the SAME Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline update, additionally exported as a plain (unencrypted) ZIP via a genuine dlt.create_sink(format='pgp_zip') + @dlt.append_flow -- no post_export_archive.pgp_encryption block is set here, since this scenario is about path/filename parameterization, not encryption (contrast TC-SNK-003). Exercises TWO DIFFERENT, easily-conflated templating mechanisms at once: (1) transformation/parameters.py::substitute_path_parameters -- THIS session's new feature -- resolves the ${client_code}/${export_tier} placeholders found anywhere in this flow's target_config_json text (both sink_config.path and post_export_archive.output_zip_path below) fresh on every pipeline update, from this spec's own pipeline_parameters, before json.loads (see docs/17_onboarding_template_reference.md Sec 3.4); (2) archive/pgp_zip_sink.py's export_file_name_format is a wholly separate, PRE-EXISTING str.format() mechanism with its own placeholders, {batch_id}/{timestamp} -- resolved at commit time by the sink's driver-side writer directly from the microbatch id/UTC clock, NEVER from pipeline_parameters. ${client_code}/${export_tier} are deliberately NOT placed inside export_file_name_format here, unlike flowx_testing/TESTING_PLAN.md's own drafted TC-PRM-005 row (which combined both mechanisms into one 'export_file_name_format': '${client_code}_${export_tier}_export_{batch_id}' string) -- this build keeps the two mechanisms cleanly separate on purpose; see docs/69_tc_prm_005.md's 'Known gaps / judgment calls' section for the full rationale. Verify: post_export_archive.output_zip_path resolves to /Volumes/flowx/egress/ACME_CORP/output/ and a plain .zip archive lands there.
